text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're still alive, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You survived.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We're still moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after our conversation at the
hospital,
Nakayama Festa looks more
stern than normal
during training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Next year, we'll be going from the
Takarazuka
Kinen to the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's become far more skilled in this
past year,
and I've boosted my
knowledge and know-how as
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's all for the sake of our international
venture.
We've had the same goal since
her race debut.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
It isn't over. Anything can still happen to
her,
even now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Nakayama's caught on
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've got the midyear grand prix, the

Takarazuka Kinen, in June. After we win
that,
we'll shift gears toward France.
That's our best
course of action.
choice_data_list: (Even so, as a goal, there's nothing wrong with it.)

text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

The world is huge, vast, and full of
people aiming
for the top!

But reaching for it on your lonesome is
the
pinnacle of naivety! You are the
quintessential
amateur! See, what you
really need is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Teamwooork!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! Mhm, mhm! You're in promising
form, just
as your runs in the Kikuka Sho
and Chunichi
Shimbun Hai showed!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get going, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm ready! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is a runner in El Condor
Pasa's
generation who earned the
moniker "Ruler of
Japan" after
overcoming the powerful
competition in
the international Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Coming through!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwip!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't move so much! You'll
hurt
yourself if I drop you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What do you think my trainer is? A
sack of
rice?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We need to make it to the airplane in
time! We've
already filled out the leave
request form! We just
need someone to
sign it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama, you want to win the Arc,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Of course I do.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then, quit dawdlin' and follow me, or
you'll be
late to my special
extracurricular course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrrrooom!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Keep going, El! I don't think there's
much snow
past this point!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Muy bien! Nice going, Spe! Okay, let's
keep up
the pace!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just how far are we going?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive at a vast, open clearing.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are so many different kinds
of terrain
near your hometown, Spe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Right then, let's start timing ourselves.
We'll start
with 800 meters. Trainer,
here, use my stopwatch!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No tracks here, I'm afraid! Our course is
to run
straight through this big open
field!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The training facility over there is
different in both
size and what it offers
compared to Tracen, so we
won't be
able to do our usual training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A straight shot, no turns or gimmicks...
So this is
how the best train, huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Vamos! Training out here in the
countryside will
do you better than the
big city.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, go ahead 800 meters that way
and wait
for us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As requested, I move 800 meters away
and stand
ready. From this distance, the
girls look as small
as grains of rice.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll give the start signal over the phone!
Make sure
you don't miss it!
choice_data_list: I can't see what they're doing over there at all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear her voice come through the
speaker of my
phone. It seems the best
way to communicate at
this distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This way, I can know clearly when to
start the
stopwatch.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: On your marks! Get set! Gooo!
choice_data_list: ...There's this kind of approach too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa goes on to teach us more
of her
personal training techniques.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She teaches us everything from ways to
relax
before starting a run, to useful
French phrases
that'll help us find
training partners once we
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the articles and records in the world
can't
amount to personal insight from an
Umamusume
with experience. What she
teaches us provides a
whole new
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: By the way El, why are you helping us?
choice_data_list: (There's so much for us to learn.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're gaining a fortune, but what's in it
for you?
You were really hostile toward
me at the
beginning of all this.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What's past is past. Plus, don't you
remember
what I said?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Teamwork is essential when racing
overseas! So,
I'm recruiting you into my
team!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, no. Not like that. In this team,
Nakayama's
the player.
choice_data_list: Does that mean we're joining forces?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Which makes you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You can just call me Professor El. ♪ All
right? Our
next training session will start
in ten minutes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Great job, El! Being a teacher really suits
you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gracias a ti, Spe! Your mom giving us a
lift when
we needed it was a huge
lifesaver too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it! I just wanted to help out.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Also, it's fun thinking back on when you

competed in France and when that racer
came
here to Japan and ran against me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass told me you were looking for a
rough gem
to take under your wing.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But Nakayama is far from being a
rough
gem. She's more like a burning
igneous rock.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching Nakayama and how
she
tackled the Triple Crown races, and
there's no
one like her.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There's no one else out there who gives
me this
much hope for the future.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That makes a lot of sense, then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been thinking—us
Umamusume, we
dream together, we
carry each other's dreams,
and we
entrust our dreams to others.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm supporting you! 'Cause
you once
entrusted me with your dream!
Now I want us to
have a new dream,
together!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue the day, training until
sunset. After
contacting the academy,
we check into a nearby
inn and sleep
like rocks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We're baaaack!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Did you give some thought
to my
suggestion of teaming up?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I don't have issues with it either.
choice_data_list: It's more than we could ever ask for, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Great! Then our tag-team is official! All
right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Teach. Hold on a sec.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Teach? Nakayama gets calls from her
teacher?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So Nakayama's elementary
school teacher
has been a big mentor for
her, and now she wants
to give her
mentor hope to live life fully...
choice_data_list: No, not a teacher at Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why Nakayama has so
much more
passion than other racers.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She's betting on the most precious thing
we
have—life.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And it's all for the sake of giving hope...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! How unexpected! Shocking!
Surprising!
She's just like me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Style is one thing, but I'm talkin' about
what's on
the inside!
choice_data_list: You think so? I feel like their styles are pretty different, though.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Which is why...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nakayama must win, no matter what.
